edge_labels: Exploiting path traversal in api/settings/log yields arbitrary file access, allowing attacker to harvest web console and OS credentials
Harvested credentials provide authenticated access to RaspAP 2.5 web interface
Harvested OS configuration confirms unchanged default account 'pi' with password 'raspberry'
OS command execution via includes/webconsole.php enables interactive shell access to invoke sudo using default credentials
Full root permissions allow attacker to manipulate hardware sound output and execute audio routines on the Raspberry Pi
Sound played through Raspberry Pi-powered speakers modulates power line draw and LED luminescence, exposing speech signals to remote optical sensors
Local unprivileged code execution from browser exploitation provides the local access required to create log hard links for OVRRedir.exe
Local unprivileged process execution spawned from browser exploitation interacts with OVRServiceLauncher.exe to capture leaked privileged handles
Physical PCI bus connection enables hardware-level direct memory operations that exploit the IOMMU misconfiguration in Jetson Linux
